 Paris Saint-Germain visit Villarreal this Tuesday evening for matchday four of the Champions League league phase.
 With Ousmane Dembélé, Marquinhos, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and Nuno Mendes all out injured, Luis Enrique unsurprisingly puts his faith in his in-form players: Lucas Hernandez, Maghnes Akliouche, Désiré Doué... and Senny Mayulu! The PSG academy graduate gets the nod over Ferran Torres up front!
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The official line-ups: 
 Villarreal: Gulacsi - Freeman, Mourino, Veiga, Romero - Comesana, Gueye, Macia, Buchanan - Pepe, Pérez 
 PSG: Safonov - Hakimi, Zabarnyi, Pacho, Hernandez - Vitinha, Neves, Ruiz - Akliouche, Doué, Mayulu
